original_persona.name: Alex Chen
original_persona.background: Alex is a first-generation Chinese-American who grew up in a small town in Ohio. He moved to the Bay Area after completing his master's degree at Stanford. He values innovation and work-life balance, enjoying hiking and photography in his free time. He identifies as politically moderate and is passionate about environmental sustainability.
